messages:
sarah-sales: Hey team — AcmeCo POC starts next Mon. They asked for an ISMS applicability statement + a minimal evidence pack showing which ISO 27001 controls apply to the Redwood Private POC (VPC + customer KMS). Can we get a short applicability snippet and an evidence checklist by EOD tomorrow? cc @anya-security @mike-eng

anya-security: Quick clarify — this is Private (customer-managed VPC) with external KMS integration, right? Is telemetry to our console allowed (anonymized)?

sarah-sales: Correct — Private VPC, customer KMS. They allow anonymized telemetry to the console but logs/data remain in their account/region.

anya-security: OK. Short summary: applicable control groups are A.5/A.6 (policies/organisational), A.9 (access control), A.10 (cryptography/key mgmt), A.12 (operations), A.13 (communications), A.18 (compliance). We can produce an applicability statement + minimal evidence: policy excerpts, network diagram, KMS integration screenshot, config snippets, access control matrix, and point of contact for SOC2/ISO certs. Example blurb below — we'll tailor it to the POC:

```
Applicability statement (redwood inference)
- Scope: Redwood Private POC deployed into customer-managed VPC. Redwood is responsible for runtime service, model serving runtime, and optional control-plane telemetry; customer retains control over networking, storage, and KMS.
- Controls applicable: A.9, A.10, A.12, A.13, A.18. Controls for physical security and data residency are the customer's responsibility for on-prem POC; Redwood provides supporting evidence for its managed runtime and integrations.
```

mike-eng: From eng side we'll prepare: deployment manifest (sanitized), security group/subnet rules screenshot, bastion/ssh access process doc, KMS integration flow (ARN + IAM role example), and a short note on what runtime logs we send to console (anonymized). Also will include a minimal diagram (PNG). Please confirm customer will share KMS ARN + allowed subnets.

tom-customer: Confirming — data residency is eu-west-1 only, and we'll provide the KMS ARN and subnet list. Also want to confirm Redwood will not persist PII to your telemetry — only metrics and anonymized traces.

anya-security: We'll state that in the applicability + evidence pack: "Telemetry: anonymized metrics and traces only; no PII persisted. Customer-managed storage and KMS hold application data."

sarah-sales: Timeline check — I need to send a version of the pack to the customer Wed morning. EOD tomorrow for a minimal pack works for me.

anya-security: EOD tomorrow is tight but doable for a minimal deliverable (applicability statement, evidence checklist, 2-3 screenshots, network diagram, KMS integration note). I'll own the doc. @mike-eng please drop manifests/configs by 5pm today.

mike-eng: Will upload sanitized manifests + sg rules by 17:00. Note: we need the KMS ARN + list of allowed subnets from the customer to include an IAM role example. Pinging @tom-customer

tom-customer: Sending KMS ARN and subnets now in DM. Also will attach a copy of their ISMS boundary for reference.

deploy-bot: Heads up — iso-evidence-template updated 2026-02-10. See https://redwood.internal/docs/iso-evidence-template

anya-security: Ack :thumbsup: I'll assemble the minimal pack and put it in the shared sales folder. If we can get the KMS info and subnets today, I'll include the IAM snippet and screenshot.

sarah-sales: Awesome — thank you both. I'll follow up if customer asks for anything extra.

mike-eng: one more note: for the POC we recommend the "restrictive" security group baseline (deny by default, allow only app/metrics ports) — will include in the checklist.

tom-customer: Got it — thanks everyone.
